name: 72404 · Jonesboro, AR
findings: ZIP 72404 (Jonesboro) has 65 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 72404 (Jonesboro) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 72404 (Jonesboro) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).
